gold_difference.evaluation_rule: automated minus reference for every asserted gold row; identity miss and abstention scored as 0

blinding: Gold was used only to confirm PMID eligibility and the presence of at least one named variant assertion. No gold identities, values, or row counts were written into this run or supplied to extraction.
